_comment: Field detection and rendering spec for doc-to-form. Pin templates to a spec version so rule changes never break existing forms.

date.description: Calendar date — rendered as date picker on screen, plain underline on print

currency.html_input: <input type="number" id="{id}" name="{id}" placeholder="0.00" step="0.01" class="field currency-field"> درهم

cin.description: Moroccan National ID — format: letter + 6 digits (e.g. B123456)
cin.html_input: <input type="text" id="{id}" name="{id}" placeholder="B123456" pattern="[A-Z]{1,2}[0-9]{6}" maxlength="8" class="field cin-field">

phone.description: Moroccan phone number — 10 digits starting with 06 or 07
phone.html_input: <input type="tel" id="{id}" name="{id}" placeholder="06XXXXXXXX" pattern="0[67][0-9]{8}" maxlength="10" class="field phone-field">

checkbox.print_style: border: 1pt solid #000; width: 12pt; height: 12pt; display: inline-block;

textarea.description: Multi-line free text for longer content
textarea.print_style: border-bottom: 1pt solid #000; display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 40pt;

select.description: Dropdown — options defined per-field in template manifest

detection_rules._comment: Rules applied IN ORDER. First match wins. More specific patterns must come before broader ones.
detection_rules.name: word_formfield_text
detection_rules.label: from_bookmark_or_surrounding_text

upgrade_policy.note: When adding new rules or changing existing ones, increment the version. Templates manifest declares which spec version they were built against. The converter loads the spec version declared in the template — old templates are never affected by new rules.
backwards_compatible_changes: Adding a new detection_rule at lower priority
Changing html_input or print_style for a type
breaking_changes: Changing pattern of an existing rule
upgrade_policy.on_breaking_change: Bump major version (v1 → v2). Keep field-spec.v1.json unchanged forever.
